sql.smartlistv2.getMine: select s.*, ot.object_type, cot.object_type_id, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) as owner from flow.smartlist s inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = s.company_object_type_id inner join flow.object_type ot on ot.id = cot.object_type_id left join flow.object_type ot1 on ot1.id = s.view_object_type_id inner join flow.user u on u.id = s.owner_id where cot.company_id = :companyId and s.owner_id = :userId and s.archived is not true and s.work_queue_type_id is null
